trailhead.label: Guarda village centre, the board’s start

cautions: Most of the walk is on a small road: lead short for the odd car.
Little shade on the sunny terrace: carry water on hot days.
A descent of 274 m into Ardez: take it slowly with older dogs.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
